name: GitHub views and clones — daily
description: Latest observed count per UTC reporting day. Repeated collections replace earlier snapshots. Missing days remain missing; GitHub traffic is separate from app activity.

source.query:
SELECT day,
    sumIf(total_count, metric = 'views') AS views,
    sumIf(total_count, metric = 'clones') AS clones
FROM (
    SELECT toDate(properties.report_day) AS day,
        properties.traffic_metric AS metric,
        argMax(toInt(properties.total_count), timestamp) AS total_count
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'github_traffic_snapshot'
        AND properties.source = 'github'
        AND properties.repository = 'wovenmatter/wovenmatter'
        AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 45 DAY
        AND toDate(properties.report_day) >= toDate(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    GROUP BY day, metric
)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

name: GitHub unique viewers and cloners — daily
description: GitHub daily unique counts, using the latest observation for each day. Do not add these to derive weekly or monthly unique people.

source.query:
SELECT day,
    sumIf(daily_unique_count, metric = 'views') AS daily_unique_viewers,
    sumIf(daily_unique_count, metric = 'clones') AS daily_unique_cloners
FROM (
    SELECT toDate(properties.report_day) AS day,
        properties.traffic_metric AS metric,
        argMax(toInt(properties.daily_unique_count), timestamp) AS daily_unique_count
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'github_traffic_snapshot'
        AND properties.source = 'github'
        AND properties.repository = 'wovenmatter/wovenmatter'
        AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 45 DAY
        AND toDate(properties.report_day) >= toDate(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    GROUP BY day, metric
)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

name: Installer downloads — DMG
description: GitHub installer download totals across website, direct GitHub, in-app updates, repeats and internal downloads. Supporting files are excluded. These are downloads, not installations or unique people.

source.query:
SELECT argMax(toInt(properties.cumulative_dmg_downloads), timestamp) AS cumulative_dmg_downloads
FROM events
WHERE event = 'github_download_snapshot'
    AND properties.source = 'github'
    AND properties.repository = 'wovenmatter/wovenmatter'
    AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY

name: Installer downloads — cumulative observations
description: Last known installer-only DMG counters by observation day, including replaced installers and repeats. Supporting files are excluded. Historical daily download deltas are not inferred.

source.query:
SELECT toDate(properties.report_day) AS day,
    argMax(toInt(properties.cumulative_dmg_downloads), timestamp) AS dmg_downloads
FROM events
WHERE event = 'github_download_snapshot'
    AND properties.source = 'github'
    AND properties.repository = 'wovenmatter/wovenmatter'
    AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 45 DAY
    AND toDate(properties.report_day) >= toDate(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

name: GitHub collection time — UTC
description: Latest stored observation for traffic and download snapshots. The nightly collector starts after the analytics workflow reaches main.

source.query:
SELECT event AS snapshot_type, max(timestamp) AS last_collected_utc
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('github_traffic_snapshot', 'github_download_snapshot')
    AND properties.source = 'github'
    AND properties.repository = 'wovenmatter/wovenmatter'
    AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY event
ORDER BY event
